policy: Only private path prefixes are replaced in local evidence; all numerical fields and log lines are preserved.
The two golden files differ from their original bytes only in the checkpoint path label.
Remote evidence is already sanitized; cuda-4080/sanitization.json links it to the original raw inputs.
Full memory timelines, model weights, unrelated GPU process commands, and model binaries are not published.
Source snapshot hashes identify files at their recorded stage; historical test receipts identify their own binaries. They do not establish later-stage success.
Stage 4 evidence was added after completion; its frozen source manifest and successful build records identify the server used by both HTTP runs.

Stage 4 weighted DeltaNet and partial CPU text-014 diagnostics were added later without changing earlier copied evidence or source hashes. These runs precede subsequent normalization, serial-wait, and 27B GEMM-shape changes.
Stage 4 shared-machine latency and Stage 5 normalization source/CUDA oracle evidence were added separately; the latency binary precedes the normalization and serial-wait changes.

Stage 5 builds, bounded GPU checks, native 27B comparison, and independent CPU-head reference are identified by their own source and binary hashes. MPS probes are diagnostic; no failed result or acceptance threshold is replaced.
